title: The eruption that destroyed Pompeii is helping scientists date Earth’s history
summary: Historical accounts of the eruption nearly 2,000 years ago provide a precise timeline that allowed recalibration of one of the most versatile dating methods. The post The eruption that destroyed Pompeii is helping scientists date Earth’s history appeared first on Berkeley News .
